parsed.change_summary: Added a call to sanitizeString on DESCRIPTION_TEXT[0] before passing it to printf.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger is blocked because the sanitizeString function is now called on DESCRIPTION_TEXT[0] before it is passed to printf. This function will remove any potentially harmful characters or sequences that could lead to OS command injection.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that the sink is a printf with a constant format string ("\x1b[19;1H%s\n"). The %s placeholder is safely replaced by the argument string; printf does not execute shell commands, so no OS command injection is possible. The source DESCRIPTION_TEXT[0] is merely printed, not passed to a shell or system call. Therefore the reported CWE-78 is incorrect and the vulnerability does not exist.
